title: Fabulous food tour with Elvira.
text: I had a delightful experience with Elvira. She tailored the tour to my interests and was incredibly flexible as the tour progressed. She provided SO much interesting information about not just Barcelona’s amazing culinary offerings but also history and culture. She took me to places I never would have found myself, some spots where she knew the owners who were eager to provide a great experience. I highly recommend booking time with Elvira if you’re lucky enough to be in Barcelona.
author: edganda

title: Experience Barcelona through the eyes of a local
text: Have been to Barcelona before but mainly for work and never had the extra time to really explore the city properly. Found GoLocal Barcelona online. What an amazing way to not only explore the city but learn more about its food scene, history, culture and architecture through a walking tour guided by - a local! She shared her personal favourite places and each one was an absolute jewel. Neat little tucked away places I would never have found on my own. Would highly recommend.
author: Sunshine60889594138

title: Amazing food, amazing guide
text: We had a wonderful tour with Alex! He was so welcoming and we appreciated his flexibility and care in making sure our young kids also had an enjoyable experience. Beyond the amazing food, he was so knowledgeable and helpful in sharing thoughtful recommendations for the rest of our trip. Would not hesitate to book the tour again!
author: 619frannyg

title: Best food tour guide in Spain!  ELVIRA
text:
My last time in Barcelona was Spring 1969 as I was driving to Sitges.  This time I spent 4 nights there with a friend and we hired Elvira for 2 nights of fun, food, and Spanish frolic!   She knew where to take the 4 of us, which TAPAS to order,  and everyone was amazing!  We went to places most tourists would pass on the street!  She knew the folks that ran the cafes  and restaurants and we were served fast some of the best food and drinks ever!  
I would recommend Everyone who travels to Barcelona to hire Elvira for a food tour!  She’s so positive, fun AND speaks perfect English!   My best 2
author: 670dustyr

title: Family tour in the Gothic quarter
text: We had a great time on our tour with Alex, who was an incredible guide. From the very beginning, he was gracious, welcoming, and highly knowledgeable about Spanish food culture. The tapas and wine selections were fantastic — especially the paella, which was a real highlight. Highly recommend this experience!
author: Haneet_L

title: Great experience with Elvira!
text:
We had the pleasure of experiencing a food tour in Barcelona with Elvira, and it was truly exceptional. After spending five days in the city trying to savor as many native dishes as possible, Elvira took our culinary adventure to a whole new level. She guided us to three different local restaurants where we indulged in food and drinks that we would never have ordered on our own. Each dish was a delightful surprise, bursting with authentic flavors.

title: A memorable and non-touristic Barcelona food tour
text: An absolutely lovely food tour with Elvira - we tried some delicious local dishes and found out more about Barcelona’s food culture! Highly recommended
author: ritavoda

title: More than a food tour
text: More than a food tour. Had a wonderful time with Elvira, her knowledge of local food and history was amazing. Elvira took us to places that did not show up on our research before the trip and we’re so thankful that we were able to experience it. Highly recommend this tour for people interested in the culture of Barcelona and not just the food.
author: Kerryn_R

title: Eat like a local!
text: Amazing tour tailored to our desires. Charming and convivial host, good conversationalist. Excellent knowledge of non tourist local eating spots. Highly recommend.
author: jessicasG5892RH

title: Great Food Tour
text: Fun food tour in Barcelona.  We got a chance to check out Santa Caterina, a local restaurant and wine/cheese shop.  It was fun to walk around the Gothic Quarter with Alex.  He was very patient and accommodating.
